article.title: Storage
article.body: Our customers have the choice of storing their assets at the Royal Canadian Mint, the U.K., Switzerland, or in the United States at vaults managed by MKS PAMP, APMEX, Brinks, Loomis International, or other Comex-approved vaults. Either way, the metals remain fully insured, and the storage costs are low. OneGold charges only 0.12% for gold holdings and 0.30% for silver and platinum holdings. Competitors often charge higher rates based on location or holding value. Our minimums are even lower. Some charge minimums as high as $10 per month, compared to the OneGold minimum of $5 per quarter. That’s a savings of $100 per year.
